name: Quote3D for WooCommerce
author: Quote3D Developer

sections.description:
Quote3D for WooCommerce puts a 3D printing configurator on your product pages. A shopper uploads a model, picks the technology, material, colour and quantity, and sees the price at once. The quoted part goes into the WooCommerce cart at exactly that price and is paid with your usual checkout.

Prices are calculated by Quote3D, a slicing and pricing service for FDM, SLA, SLS, MJF and SLM printing. You set up your printers, materials, colours and prices in Quote3D, or from the plugin’s Catalogue page.

In the shop

  • Configurator on any product page (tick “Quote3D configurator”) or anywhere with the [quote3d_widget] shortcode.
  • The price is read again from Quote3D on your server when a part is added to the cart, so it cannot be changed in the browser.
  • The quoted quantity is locked in the classic cart and in the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • A colour that ran out of stock cannot be ordered.

In the admin (Quote3D menu)

  • Overview: quotes, carts, orders and revenue for any period, plus the health of the connection.
  • Quotes: every quote a shopper added to a cart, and whether it was ordered.
  • Production: a print queue of sold parts with print settings, model downloads and “mark printed”.
  • Catalogue: printers, materials, colours, colour stock and prices, saved in Quote3D.
  • Reports and CSV export.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 6.0 or later.
  • A Quote3D account. A free plan is available; paid plans raise the monthly quote, storage and technology limits. See pricing. The plugin contains all of its code; the limits are applied by the Quote3D service.

External services

This plugin connects to Quote3D (https://quote3d.com and https://api.quote3d.com), a service run by VARANTECH ENERJİ SAN. TİC. LTD. ŞTİ. Nothing is sent to Quote3D before you save a Quote3D token in the plugin settings.

  • Configurator script. On product pages where you turned the configurator on, and on pages with the [quote3d_widget] shortcode, the shopper’s browser loads https://quote3d.com/js/quote3d-embed.js. The model file the shopper uploads and the print options they choose are sent from their browser to Quote3D to calculate the price. The widget token (a public token limited to quoting) is part of the page.
  • Adding to the cart. Your server reads the quote from api.quote3d.com (quote ID, price, quantity, material, colour, print settings, preview image) with your server token, and asks whether the colour is in stock.
  • Admin pages. Your plan, limits, usage, catalogue and stock are read from and saved to Quote3D with your server token. The server token never leaves your server.
  • Webhook. When you save a server token, the plugin registers your site’s REST address (/wp-json/quote3d/v1/webhook) with Quote3D, so Quote3D can report deleted model files and usage alerts. It is removed when the token is removed or the plugin is deactivated.
  • Orders. When an order is paid, cancelled or refunded, the order number and its quote IDs are sent so Quote3D can take material out of stock or put it back. No customer name, address, email or payment detail is sent.
  • Model files. If you turn it on, model files are deleted on Quote3D some days after the order is delivered. They are also deleted when you run a personal data erasure request for the customer.
  • Every request carries the header X-Quote3D-Client: woocommerce/<version>.

Quote3D Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then this plugin.
  2. The setup wizard opens: create a free Quote3D account (or sign in), paste your widget token and server token, and choose the cart product quotes are added as.
  3. Open a product and tick “Quote3D configurator”, or put [quote3d_widget] on any page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Quote3D account?

Yes. Quote3D slices the model and calculates the price. There is a free plan.

Which currency is used?

Your WooCommerce store currency. Set the same currency in Quote3D (Catalogue › Pricing); a quote in another currency is not added to the cart.

What about tax?

Leave the Quote3D tax rate at 0 and let WooCommerce add tax, or enter WooCommerce prices inclusive of tax. The plugin refuses to add a quote that would be taxed twice and says why on the Overview page.

Where are the uploaded files stored?

On Quote3D, under your account. You can download them from the Production page and have them deleted after delivery.

Does it work with the Cart and Checkout blocks and HPOS?

Yes, both.

In which languages is the plugin available?

English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Chinese and Japanese are included. The admin pages follow your WordPress language; the configurator’s language is chosen in Quote3D › Settings. More languages can be added on translate.wordpress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.4.3

  • Bundled German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Russian, Turkish and Chinese translations now follow the WordPress.org glossaries and style guides.

1.4.2

  • Usage warnings now appear only on WooCommerce screens and link to the plugin’s overview page.

1.4.1

  • A cancelled quote that is ordered again is taken out of stock again and goes back into the print queue.
  • The admin pages no longer need WordPress’s script loader to reach the plugin’s REST routes (shared with the other Quote3D store modules).

1.4.0

  • The same quote can no longer be ordered twice; a paid quote left in another cart is removed at checkout.
  • Quotes that already include Quote3D tax are refused when WooCommerce would add tax again.
  • Multi-currency plugins no longer block adding quotes: the store’s base currency is compared.
  • Stock changes and file deletions whose background job was lost are picked up again; stock calls are split into batches of 100.
  • A file shared with a cancelled or abandoned order no longer blocks its deletion.
  • Production: searching by the displayed order number works with sequential order number plugins; a deleted order no longer breaks the Orders view.
  • Security: the Quote3D address must use https; repeated webhook deliveries are handled once; unknown quote IDs from one address are rate limited.
  • Admin notices can be dismissed and only appear on the Dashboard, Plugins and WooCommerce screens.
  • Personal data export, suggested privacy policy text and full clean-up when the plugin is deleted.
  • Logs go to WooCommerce › Status › Logs (source “quote3d”).
  • Translations use WordPress’s gettext: the admin pages follow your WordPress language; the configurator’s language is chosen in the settings.
  • Unlimited plans no longer show “0 left” under the usage rings.
  • Updates now come from WordPress.org.

1.3.0

  • Quote3D menu with Overview, Quotes, Production, Catalogue, Reports and a setup wizard.
  • Colour stock, catalogue management and model file clean-up.

1.2.5

  • “Go to cart” after adding a quote.

short_description: Instant 3D printing quotes in WooCommerce: shoppers upload an STL, OBJ or 3MF file, get a price and add the part to the cart.
